tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Signs in to a stored Supabase MCP server profile and optionally creates/updates an auth identity and/or exchanges provided credentials for an authenticated session; returns the resolved server connection settings and, when requested, the created/selected session metadata. Validates IDs and enums (server_id/session_id format, environment, provider) and rejects invalid combinations (e.g., missing secret when create_session is true and no session_id is provided, unknown base_url, or providing both session_id and create_session); raises UNAUTHORIZED when credentials are invalid or the caller lacks access to the server/profile, FORBIDDEN when access policy disallows the requested action, NOT_FOUND when server_id or session_id does not exist, CONFLICT when the requested identity/session cannot be created due to an existing incompatible record, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when sign-in/session exchanges exceed quota.

server_id.description: ID of the MCP server profile to sign in to and manage.

environment.description: Target environment of the server profile to use.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Supabase MCP server to connect to.

provider.description: Authentication provider to use when exchanging credentials for a session.

account_label.description: Human-friendly label for the authenticated account/credential set.

secret.description: Raw credential material used to sign in (e.g., PAT/token/key); stored encrypted by the backend.

create_identity.description: Whether to create/update an auth identity record for the provided credentials.

create_session.description: Whether to exchange the provided credentials for an authenticated session.

session_id.description: Existing session ID to use instead of creating a new one.

tool_schemas.name: List MCP Servers
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored Supabase MCP server connection profiles visible to the signed-in server identity. Supports filtering by lifecycle status and environment and returns a paginated result set; refuses invalid filters.

q.description: Case-insensitive search over server name and base_url.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: Create MCP Server
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Supabase MCP server connection profile. Returns the created server record; refuses invalid environment/base_url, duplicate names within the same environment when disallowed by policy, or attempts to create deleted servers.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the MCP server profile.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Supabase MCP server (e.g., https://...).

environment.description: Target environment for this server profile.

tool_schemas.name: Update MCP Server
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing MCP server profile (name/base_url/environment) and/or drives lifecycle transitions via status. Returns the updated server record; refuses illegal status transitions, and when disabling a server revokes all active sessions for that server.

server_id.description: ID of the MCP server profile to update.

base_url.description: New base URL of the Supabase MCP server.

status.description: Lifecycle status to transition to. Allowed: active→disabled/deleted, disabled→active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: List Auth Sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists authenticated sessions for a server and/or identity. Returns a paginated set of session metadata (never raw tokens); on read, sessions with expires_at in the past are treated as expired and may be reflected as such in results.

server_id.description: Filter sessions by MCP server profile ID.

identity_id.description: Filter sessions by auth identity ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: Update Auth Session
tool_schemas.description: Updates an auth session and/or drives lifecycle transitions (e.g., revoke, mark error, or reactivate via refresh). Returns the updated session metadata; refuses illegal transitions, refuses creating a new active session when another active session exists for the same (server_id, identity_id) unless the previous one is revoked/expired as part of the operation.

session_id.description: ID of the auth session to update.

status.description: Lifecycle status to transition to. Allowed: active→expired/revoked/error; expired/error→active/revoked.

last_error.description: Optional error description when setting status=error; secrets must not be included.

refresh.description: When true, attempts to refresh/reactivate the session using stored credentials and updates expires_at/status accordingly; refuses if identity/server is revoked/disabled/deleted.

metadata.name: Query | MCP Server for Supabase
metadata.description: This backend stores Supabase MCP server connection profiles and authenticated sessions used to access and manage Supabase projects through a signed-in server identity. The main workflow is creating/maintaining server records, exchanging credentials for sessions, and enforcing access controls/auditab
